## Stay Curious, Stay Compassionate

Hello! I'm **Zimo (Zina) Ma**, a **graduate student** at the **University of Chicago**, pursuing a **Master of Arts in Computational Social Science** (expected **June 2025**). My academic and professional journey blends **data science** with **social impact**, aiming to decode complex human behaviors and promote equitable solutions.

### Education Background

I hold a **Bachelor of Arts** in **Mathematics and Psychology** from **DePauw University**. My interdisciplinary training integrates quantitative modeling with behavioral insights, equipping me to tackle real-world challenges.  

### Research Experience

At the **University of Chicago**, my research focuses on **biases in hiring practices** and developing data-driven strategies to promote fairer employment decisions. My **MA Thesis** explores **visual stereotypes in the workplace**, investigating how **facial attributes**—such as attractiveness and gender—affect **job suitability assessments** in **client-facing vs. back-office roles**.

Previously, as a **Research Analyst** at **DePauw University**, I analyzed **gender disparities** using GIS and statistical methods, examining how **natural disasters disproportionately impact Indian women**. I also studied the **effects of COVID-19 on STEM education**, applying Chi-Square tests and t-tests to assess disparities in learning experiences.

➡️ **Check out my work under the "Projects" section!**  

### Future Goals  

I am passionate about **machine learning, data visualization,** and using **computational methods** to drive **social impact**.
